title: Implement the disposable storage-rehearsal harness
goal: After T001 and T002 are terminal and independently reviewed, implement and review the effect-free storage/recovery rehearsal harness as an intentionally standalone component patch from the canonical architecture baseline. The harness encodes the canonical GPT + EFI + recovery + LUKS2 + Btrfs topology, disposable-target preflight, restore/reconstruction workflow and evidence readback contracts without executing partitioning, formatting, LUKS creation or boot mutation. T005 publishes no Git ref; instead it creates a content-addressed rehearsal-patch artifact that T007 later verifies against the exact T005 terminal commit and integrates with T006 while preserving Git ancestry.

approval.note: This task is implementation-only. Its Bureau run-scoped worktree intentionally uses the initiative's canonical architecture commit b0c1745b077dcdc0bea0381cbf2dc247994e5dc9 as the frozen baseline; it does not claim to include T001/T002/T006 source changes. It may change and test only the rehearsal implementation paths and create the leased immutable rehearsal-patch artifact. It may not publish a Git ref, perform source integration, execute sgdisk, wipefs, cryptsetup luksFormat, mkfs, boot mutation or equivalent block-device effects. T007 owns exact source integration and T008 prepares the final protected PR, T009 alone owns its protected main merge and T010 seals the merged source; T003 owns the real disposable rehearsal.

acceptance.assertion: Before repository mutation, the recorded Bureau workspace baseline equals canonical architecture commit b0c1745b077dcdc0bea0381cbf2dc247994e5dc9 and the run-scoped worktree is clean. T005 is explicitly a standalone component patch and does not claim T001, T002 or T006 source ancestry; any different baseline or hidden integration fails closed. T007 is the only task authorized to combine this patch with T006.

The reviewed rehearsal harness declaratively encodes GPT + EFI System Partition + recovery/boot-recovery surface + LUKS2 + Btrfs with exactly @root, @nix, @persist, @home, @data and @containers, and tests reject topology drift.

The harness requires an explicitly supplied blank disposable target and cannot infer or default to a production block device; missing target identity fails closed before any destructive command could be constructed.

Preflight logic requires fresh target/backing evidence and rejects any target matching the productive Heim-PC root backing, mounted production filesystems or current production device identity; historical nvme0n1/SN850X references are never accepted as current authority.

Partitioning, wipe, LUKS, filesystem and boot commands are generated/executed only behind a runtime executor that requires separate exclusive sandbox authority; unit tests prove this repository task cannot cross that boundary.
The harness implements independent readback that verifies GPT partitions, LUKS2 unlock, Btrfs filesystem and all required subvolumes/mounts rather than trusting command exit status alone.

The harness defines staged restore and fresh-system reconstruction checks that consume independently sourced off-host backup material without requiring the production system SSD, Grabowski, Bureau or network during the offline-recovery proof.

Evidence schemas separately bind backup coverage, restore usability, bootable recovery media, offline source/lock/trust roots and LUKS/recovery material; a currently green scoped backup alone cannot satisfy full-cutover recovery readiness.

After the exact standalone T005 head is independently reviewed, the run creates the leased artifact.heim-pc.nixos-rehearsal-patch as a content-addressed create-only handoff. Its immutable manifest binds canonical baseline commit/tree, terminal T005 commit/tree, normalized patch/content digest, exact touched-path set and review evidence; immediate re-hash/readback proves the artifact matches the reviewed component delta. T007 does not require the T005 live worktree or a moving ref, but it must verify that this exact terminal T005 commit object remains present in the exclusively claimed Git object store and matches the artifact before ancestry-preserving integration.

T005 performs no git push and creates or updates no remote Git ref. Its durable successor handoff is the content-addressed rehearsal-patch artifact plus exact terminal commit/review evidence; final remote publication belongs only to T008.

This task terminates without source integration, main-branch merge, remote branch publication, sgdisk, wipefs, cryptsetup luksFormat, mkfs, real EFI mutation, Secure-Boot key mutation, firmware write, productive nixos-install, productive switch, reboot into a new OS or equivalent block-device/runtime effect. T007 owns final source integration and T008 prepares the final protected PR, T009 alone owns its protected main merge and T010 seals the merged source.

Focused effect-free harness, target-guard, topology-readback and recovery-contract tests plus required repository CI are green on the exact reviewed standalone T005 head before T005 is terminal. Integrated compatibility with T001/T002/T006 is deliberately proven later by T007 from immutable artifacts and exact commit lineage.
